arms.name: random_densetail10_tail20
arms.purpose: conservative allocation control receives one additional step and greater cost

execution.steps_1_through_95: dense forward with gathered unscaled 87.5% FFN backward
execution.terminal_sparse_arm_steps: the final 10 updates use native dense forward and backward with no masks, scaling, or gather/scatter
execution.averaging: uniform mean of the final 20 parameter states: ten sparse-update states followed by ten terminal-dense states
execution.dense_reference: unchanged ordinary dense training with the same uniform final-20 averaging
execution.deployment: ordinary dense inference with averaged weights

cost_accounting.sparse_steps: realized-row CPU-calibrated 87.5% FFN sparse-backward formula plus scoring and gather/scatter
cost_accounting.terminal_dense_steps: full native dense forward/backward cost with no sparse auxiliary charges
cost_accounting.averaging_aux: one parameter copy per step plus twenty final parameter reductions per arm

primary_endpoint: final uniform-tail dense held-out loss at training-plus-terminal-dense-plus-averaging cost

decision_rules.allocation_failure: terminal-dense low_max_abs does not beat terminal-dense random despite random receiving more steps and cost; stop
decision_rules.no_level_3: terminal-dense low_max_abs beats random but not the unchanged dense-tail reference; stop
decision_rules.development_level_3: low_max_abs tail loss is below random and dense-tail while total cost is no greater than either
decision_rules.confirmation: only development_level_3 launches the identical body-7 comparison

prohibited: changing the number or position of terminal dense steps after launch
adding periodic anchors, gradient scaling, or temperature calibration
excluding terminal dense or averaging costs
launching body 7 without a development-level win
